title: Raman Spectroscopy Combined with Machine Learning Reveals Myalgic Encephalomyelitis-Associated Biomolecular Signatures at Rest and After Standardized Stress.
summary: Linear L1 SVM reduced Raman features, then gradient-boosted trees classified 115 ME cases versus 45 controls using spectra, age and sex. Five-fold CV kept observations from the same participant within a single fold; reported AUCs 0.85 at rest and 0.83 post-stress.

evidence.tested: Linear L1 SVM reduced Raman features, then gradient-boosted trees classified 115 ME cases versus 45 controls using spectra, age and sex. Five-fold CV kept observations from the same participant within a single fold; reported AUCs 0.85 at rest and 0.83 post-stress. A gradient-boosted classifier applied to Raman plasma spectra distinguished ME cases from controls at rest and after standardized exertional stress in five-fold cross-validation; the study reports AUC 0.85 and 0.83. Results are preliminary and require larger independent validation.
